artworks.title: Polyhymnia
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, facing slightly to the side with her head turned forward. She has arched brows, large eyes, and delicate lips. Her dark hair is styled over her shoulders. She is dressed in flowing drapery, holding a caduceus in her right hand, with books at her feet. The background is textured, without a distinct scene.

artworks.title: Urania
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated from the waist up, with her body angled slightly to the right. She looks upwards with a contemplative expression. Her long hair flows down her shoulders. She wears a loose-fitting garment with a fabric pleat tied at the chest. In her right hand, she holds a large spherical object. An armillary sphere is on the floor near her feet, along with an open book. Her bare feet are visible. The background has an intricately textured cross-hatched pattern.

artworks.title: Jacques de la Faille
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image features a man in Renaissance attire, posing with a helmet and sword. He has wavy hair, a beard, and a serious expression. The man is surrounded by ornate decorations, including two figures playing musical instruments and a military theme. In the background, there are clouds and two figures with a flag.

artworks.title: Josina Hamels
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with both hands resting on a skull on a table before her. She is facing slightly to her left with a composed expression. She has delicate facial features, a pointed chin, and an elaborate updo. She wears a dress with puffed sleeves and a high ruff collar. The background of the oval frame surrounding her depicts a countryside scene with a town in the distance and people gathered around a fire. The frame includes decorative elements like musical figures and foliage. A book is on the table beside the skull.

artworks.title: Letter A
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the letter "A" surrounded by skeletal figures. The large, ornate letter "A" is intricately entwined with the skeletons, with one playing a horn and another holding a circular object. The background is detailed and adds depth to the macabre theme. The drawing has an antiquated style reminiscent of Renaissance artists.

artworks.title: Letter B
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative letter 'B'. The image features a large, ornately designed letter 'B', flanked by two skeleton figures and a smaller animated scene. The intricate detailing of the figures and the gothic style of the letter suggest a medieval or Renaissance influence. The scene within the letter seems to convey a sense of motion and complexity, with intertwining lines and detailed textures enhancing its depth and intricacy.

artworks.title: Letter C
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton interacting with an elderly figure within a letter "Q". The scene depicts a bearded, robed figure being led by a skeleton, both intertwined in the loop of a large, capital "Q". The skeleton, with visible ribcage and skull, is shown in profile, grasping the figure's arm. The elderly figure appears to be looking downward, draped in flowing robes. The entire composition is detailed with fine lines. The drawing's square framing, crosshatching for shading, and dramatic subject matter give it the appearance of a scene from a medieval or Renaissance motif.

artworks.title: Letter D
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate letter 'D'. The letter 'D' is designed in a Gothic style with intricate detailing featuring skeletal figures and skulls. The skeletal figures are intertwined with the letter itself, creating a sense of movement. The artwork is bordered by a thin line that frames the letter, and the entire piece is rendered in a monochromatic palette. The drawing has an aged appearance, with dark lines set against a light background.

artworks.title: Letter E
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate letter "E". The image shows an elaborate woodcut design with the letter "E" at its center, surrounded by intricate figures and elements. A skeleton figure is positioned to the left side of the letter. Opposite the skeleton, there is a heavily robed individual, possibly holding a large curved object. The design within this letter is in a style reminiscent of late medieval or early Renaissance woodcut illustrations.

artworks.title: Letter F
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton and a robed figure encased in the letter 'F'. The image depicts a skeleton on the left side standing with a walking stick. The central figure is wearing a cloak with a high collar and appears to be in a seated position. Both figures are framed and partially obscured by the capital letter "F" which dominates the center of the composition. The lines and details suggest a style reminiscent of medieval woodcut illustrations. The square border contains the entire scene, giving it an enclosed composition typical of historical manuscript illustrations.

artworks.title: Letter G
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton and a person in a robe inside an elaborate letter "C". The skeletal figure on the left is holding a large scythe. The figure in the middle is wearing a robe and a crown, surrounded by scroll-like designs. The scene is enclosed within the shape of a letter "C", with fine lines in the background for texture. The style resembles medieval or Renaissance woodcuts, with intricate linework and symbolic imagery.

artworks.title: Letter H
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative initial featuring intricate designs surrounding the letter "H" within a square frame. The design includes detailed figures, such as a skeleton, and patterns that suggest fabric and skeletal elements. The drawing is heavily shaded with fine lines, giving it a dimensional appearance consistent with intricate woodcuts seen in medieval or renaissance artwork. The drawing is monochrome, emphasizing the contrast between the bold letter and the detailed imagery.

artworks.title: Letter I
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows a small, square woodcut with two figures around a large letter 'I' in the center. The figure on the left is a bearded person in a long robe with fur around the collar. They are gesturing upwards with one hand, and the other hand may be on their chest. The person has short, wavy hair and a bushy beard. To the right is a skeleton in tattered garments, facing the bearded person. The skeleton appears animated with clear skull and bone structure. There are no visible objects held by either figure. The background has a lined pattern, possibly suggesting an interior space or abstract setting, with the figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: Letter K
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of an ornate letter 'K' with two figures in historical attire. The left figure is skeletal with a long conical hat, while the right figure is dressed in detailed robes with a chain around the neck and a wide-brimmed hat. The drawing features fine lines and intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Letter L
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate letter "I" flanked by two figures. The image features a decorative illustration where the central theme is the letter "I" presented in an elaborate manner. On the left side of the letter, there is a skeletal figure, adorned in a robe, with the appearance of a scythe in its hand. On the right, another robed figure stands holding a musical instrument. The scene is framed, giving a sense of formality and emphasis to the composition. The style is reminiscent of medieval or Renaissance woodcuts, characterized by strong contrasts and fine line work.

artworks.title: Letter M
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is an image of a letter "M" with intricate details inside and around it. The central focus is a large, decorative letter "M" which encompasses a scene within its borders. To the left, a figure with a solemn expression holds up a parchment or a sheet. The character appears to be in traditional garb with pleated fabric. Adjacent to this figure, slightly behind, is an image of a skeletal figure that leans towards the central character. Behind them, there is a table with stacked books and a lit candle casting rays of light. The scene is surrounded by dense, crosshatched patterns.

artworks.title: Letter N
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate letter 'N' with figures within its design. The intricate woodcut design of the letter features skeleton figures and a figure in period attire. The illustration is characterized by finely detailed lines and shading, contributing to a dramatic atmosphere typical of medieval or early Renaissance art styles. The figures and the letter are enclosed within a square border.

artworks.title: Letter O
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure wielding a scythe engaged in a dynamic scene with another character. The image showcases intricate linework showing movement as the skeletal figure confronts the character. The skeletal figure is depicted with a scythe, while the other character is portrayed in robes. The dark outlines and expressive lines add depth to the scene, and the use of space creates tension within the frame. The drawing is monochromatic, giving it a classic appearance.

artworks.title: Letter P
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative initial letter 'P'. The design features two skeletal figures on each side of the letter. The figures are engaged in a dynamic pose, with one holding a banner or flag while the other is gesturing. The skeletal forms are detailed with attention to anatomical elements such as ribs and joint articulation. The letter 'P' is centered with flourishes blending into the surrounding figures. The composition suggests a Gothic or medieval influence, with figures and lettering enclosed within a rectangular border emphasizing ornate typography found in illuminated manuscripts.

artworks.title: Letter Q
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two robed figures, one of which is a skeletal figure. The image is a woodcut style depiction featuring two robed figures. One figure has a skeletal appearance. Both figures are captured in mid-motion, with their robes presented in intricate detail through the fine lines typical of woodcut technique. The composition is centered within a rectangular frame, with a letter 'Q' prominently incorporated into the design.

artworks.title: Letter R
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative initial letter "R". The design features a scene within the confines of the letter. On the left side, a figure in a jester-like outfit is holding a stick or staff, with a skull at the bottom. On the right side, another figure is wearing a garland or wreath and is carrying a large object on its shoulder. The figures are surrounded by ornate carvings and motifs, characteristic of elaborate woodcut or engraved letter designs found in old manuscripts or books.

artworks.title: Letter S
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a letter "S" with a detailed design. The image features a woman on the left and a skeletal figure with an hourglass on the right in a Renaissance-style woodcut composition. The drawing showcases intricate linework and high levels of detail in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Letter T
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two skeletons standing over a fallen man. The drawing is in black and white, featuring intricate engravings within a square border. In the center, a large letter "T" is prominent. Around this letter, two skeletal figures are depicted; one on the left holding what appears to be a musical instrument or stick, while the other on the right has a spear and a shield. They stand over a man lying on the ground, who appears to be dressed in elaborate clothing with circular patterns. The man's position suggests he has fallen, as he is reclined with his head at the lower right corner. The background is filled with lines that add depth and shading to the scene.

artworks.title: Letter V
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring an encounter between a rider and a skeleton. The central letter "V" divides the image diagonally. The figures are detailed with flowing garments and skeletal features, inside a bordered square. Swirling lines suggest movement or turmoil in the scene.
